title: Responding to the occasion
literal_meaning: Hey, you—whatever the occasion calls for.
explanation: This compressed expression advises a fitting response to the circumstances. It may interrupt someone who insists on handling every situation in the same way. The point is practical judgement about this occasion, rather than a rule that commitments can always be discarded.
meaning_odia: ସମୟ ଓ ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ଦେଖି ଉଚିତ କାମ କରିବା।
usage_example: A host changes the outdoor arrangements when rain begins instead of insisting on the original plan. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The source itself supplies an English gloss about appropriate action. The elliptical Odia is retained; the English rendering makes the implied advice explicit.
